# undercut

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:justificationStatusUndercut`](gmeow-justificationStatusUndercut.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/justificationStatusUndercut>
- **Category:** individual

- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An undercutting justification-defeat marker — the inferential or evidential link supporting the target is attacked, removing the warrant without asserting the target's negation. Aligns with [`gmeow:defeaterUndercutting`](gmeow-defeaterUndercutting.md) in the inference slice. A solver-set flag only; never reasoner-promoted.
